title: Lamb Keema Curry with Spiced Potatoes & Warm Naan

ingredients.t: 1 chicken or lamb cube in 250ml water

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cut the potato into 2cm chunks, leaving the skin on. Finely chop the onion and grate the garlic. Crumble the stock cube into 250ml just-boiled water and stir.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the lamb mince for 5–6 min, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until browned all over. Spoon away most of the fat, leaving about 1 tbsp in the pan.

steps.title: Add the onion and spices
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium. Add the cumin seeds and onion and cook for 5 min until soft. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, curry powder and turmeric and cook for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer with the potatoes
steps.text: Stir in the tomato purée, chopped tomatoes, potato and stock. Bring to a bubble, cover and simmer over a medium-low heat for 15–18 min, stirring now and then. It's ready when the potato is tender to the point of a knife and the sauce is thick.

steps.title: Warm the naan
steps.text: While the keema finishes, heat a dry frying pan over a medium heat. Flick a few drops of water over each naan and warm for 1 min each side until soft and lightly toasted. Wrap in a clean tea towel to keep warm.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir the spinach into the keema a handful at a time for 2 min until wilted. Add the garam masala and season with salt. Serve with the warm naan, a spoonful of yogurt (optional), mango chutney (optional) and coriander (optional).

basedOn: HelloFresh UK — One Pot Lamb Keema Aloo — HelloFresh recipe team

title: One-Pot Chicken Pilau with Spinach & Cooling Raita

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Rinse the rice in a sieve under cold water until it runs almost clear, then leave to drain. Thinly slice the onion, grate the carrot and garlic, and cut the chicken into 3cm chunks. Crumble the stock cube into 350ml just-boiled water.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wide saucepan or casserole with a tight-fitting lid over a medium-high heat. Season the chicken with a pinch of salt and fry for 4–5 min, turning, until golden on most sides. It will finish cooking with the rice.

steps.title: Cook the onion and spices
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and add the butter, onion and carrot. Cook for 5–6 min, stirring, until the onion is soft and turning golden. Stir in the cumin seeds, garlic, ginger paste, garam masala and turmeric for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Stir in the drained rice until every grain is glossy and coated in spice. Pour in the hot stock, stir once and bring to the boil. Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 min without lifting the lid.

steps.title: Make the raita
steps.text: While the rice cooks, finely dice the cucumber. Stir it into the yogurt with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon (optional). Keep in the fridge until needed.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and leave it covered for 10 min. For the last 3 min, quickly scatter the spinach on top and put the lid back on to wilt it. Fluff everything through with a fork and check the chicken is piping hot with no pink. Serve with the raita, lemon wedges (optional) and coriander (optional).

basedOn: HelloFresh — One-Pot Indian Chicken & Veggie Pilaf — HelloFresh recipe team

title: Chicken Tikka Kebabs in Naan with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
airFryer: Air-fry the marinated chicken at 200°C for 12–14 min, shaking halfway, until charred at the edges and cooked through. Warm the naans in the air fryer at 180°C for 2 min.

ingredients.t: 8 tbsp (2 for the marinade, 6 for the sauce)
a knob, softened, for the naans

ingredients.swap: Serve the chilli sauce at the table so each person adds their own.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the kebabs that want it.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Cut the chicken into 3cm chunks. In a bowl, mix it with the tikka paste, 2 tbsp of the yogurt and the tomato purée until well coated. Leave for at least 15 min, or cover and chill for up to 24 hr.

steps.title: Pickle the onion
steps.text: Put the sliced red onion in a small bowl. Squeeze over the juice of half the lemon, add a big pinch of salt and scrunch together with your fingers. Leave to soften and turn pink while you do the rest.

steps.title: Prep the salad and sauce
steps.text: Heat the grill to high. Shred the little gem, quarter the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the cucumber. Stir the garlic, a squeeze from the other lemon half and a pinch of salt into the remaining 6 tbsp yogurt.

steps.title: Grill the chicken
steps.text: Thread the chicken onto skewers, or spread it out on an oiled, foil-lined baking tray. Grill on the top shelf for 12–15 min, turning halfway, until charred at the edges and cooked through with no pink.

steps.title: Warm the naan
steps.text: Move the chicken to a plate and cover to keep warm. Spread the naans with the soft butter (optional) and grill for 1–2 min until puffed and lightly golden. Watch closely, as they catch quickly.

steps.title: Build the kebabs
steps.text: Lay each naan on a plate and pile on the lettuce, tomato, cucumber and chicken. Spoon over the garlic yogurt sauce and scatter with the pickled onion. Add chilli sauce (optional) and coriander (optional), then fold and eat.

basedOn: The Ethical Butcher — Chicken Tikka Kebab with Buttered Naan — Merrilees Deller & Neha Hampton

title: Chicken Balti with Charred Peppers, Onion & Naan

ingredients.swap: Leave the chillies whole so they're easy to lift out, and spoon them onto one plate only.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Finely chop 1 onion and cut the remaining half into 2cm chunks. Cut the pepper into 2cm chunks, the chicken into bite-size pieces and grate the garlic. In a jug, mix the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée, yogurt, ground coriander, turmeric, chilli powder and 1 tsp of the garam masala.

steps.title: Brown the onion
steps.text: Heat 1½ tbsp oil in a large deep frying pan or wok over a medium heat. Add the cumin seeds for 30 sec until they sizzle, then the chopped onion. Cook for 10–12 min, stirring often, until deep golden; add a splash of water if it catches.

steps.title: Cook the masala
steps.text: Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and green chillies (optional) for 1 min. Pour in the tomato mix and turn the heat to medium-high. Cook for 5 min, stirring, until thick and the oil starts to pool at the edges.

steps.title: Simmer the chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken and stir to coat it in the masala. Pour in 100ml water, cover and cook over a low heat for 15 min, stirring now and then.

steps.title: Char the peppers
steps.text: While the chicken cooks, heat the remaining ½ tbsp oil in a second frying pan over a high heat. Fry the pepper and onion chunks for 4–5 min until charred at the edges but still with some bite.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir the peppers and onion into the curry and cook uncovered for 2–3 min, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce clings. Add the remaining garam masala, the lemon juice and salt to taste. Warm the naans in the pepper pan for 1 min each side and serve with coriander (optional).

basedOn: Hari Ghotra — Chicken Balti — Hari Ghotra

title: Homemade Margherita Pizza with Fresh Basil

ingredients.swap: Scatter the basil over one pizza only, or serve it on the side.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: In a large bowl, mix the flour, yeast and ½ tsp salt. Add 160ml warm water and 1 tbsp oil and stir into a soft, slightly sticky dough. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 8–10 min until smooth and springy.

steps.title: Prove the dough
steps.text: Put the dough back in the bowl, cover with a clean tea towel and leave somewhere warm for 30–45 min, until puffy and nearly doubled. Meanwhile, heat the oven to 240°C (220°C fan) with two large baking trays inside.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Stir the garlic, mixed herbs, ½ tbsp oil and a pinch of salt and pepper into the passata. Tear the mozzarella into small pieces and pat dry with kitchen paper so the pizzas don't go soggy.

steps.title: Shape the bases
steps.text: Knock the air out of the dough and split it in two. On a floured surface, roll each piece into a thin round about 25cm across. Lay each one on a sheet of baking paper.

steps.title: Top the pizzas
steps.text: Spread half the sauce over each base, leaving a 1cm border. Scatter over the mozzarella and parmesan (optional). Drizzle with the remaining ½ tbsp oil.

steps.title: Bake and serve
steps.text: Carefully slide each pizza, still on its paper, onto a hot tray. Bake for 10–12 min, until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling and spotted brown. Scatter with basil leaves (optional), slice and serve.

basedOn: Tesco Real Food — Margherita Pizza — Tesco Recipes

title: Homemade Ham & Pineapple Pizza with Melty Mozzarella

ingredients.swap: Sprinkle the chilli flakes over one pizza only, or put them on the table.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast and ½ tsp salt in a large bowl. Pour in 160ml warm water and 1 tbsp oil and bring together into a soft, slightly tacky dough. Knead on a floured worktop for 8–10 min until it's smooth and springs back when pressed.

steps.title: Prove the dough
steps.text: Return the dough to the bowl and cover with a tea towel. Leave in a warm spot for 30–45 min, until puffed up and nearly doubled. While it rises, heat the oven to 240°C (220°C fan) with two large baking trays inside.

steps.title: Prep the toppings
steps.text: Mix the passata with the garlic, mixed herbs, the remaining ½ tbsp oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Drain the pineapple well and pat dry with kitchen paper. Tear the ham into bite-size pieces, tear the mozzarella and grate the cheddar.

steps.title: Shape the bases
steps.text: Punch the dough down and cut it in half. Roll each half on a floured surface into a thin round about 25cm across. Lift each base onto its own sheet of baking paper.

steps.title: Top the pizzas
steps.text: Spread the sauce over the bases, leaving a 1cm border. Scatter over the mozzarella and cheddar. Dot the ham and pineapple evenly over the top.

steps.title: Bake and serve
steps.text: Slide the pizzas on their paper onto the hot trays. Bake for 10–12 min, until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling. Sprinkle with chilli flakes (optional), cut into slices and serve.

basedOn: Tesco Real Food — Ham and Cheese Pizza — Tesco Recipes team

title: Cheesy Chicken & Tomato Pasta Bake with Mozzarella

ingredients.swap: Scatter the basil over one portion only, or serve it on the side.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Finely chop the onion and garlic. Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally into two thin pieces. Season with half the mixed herbs, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 3–4 min each side until golden and cooked through with no pink. Move to a board, rest for a few minutes, then cut into strips.

steps.title: Make the tomato sauce
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and add the remaining oil and the onion to the same pan. Cook for 5 min until soft, then stir in the garlic and tomato purée for 1 min. Add the passata, the remaining herbs and a pinch of salt and simmer for 10 min until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, cook the penne for 2 min less than the pack says, so it doesn't go soft in the oven. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Assemble the bake
steps.text: Stir the pasta, chicken, parmesan and a splash of the cooking water into the sauce. Tip into a medium baking dish and level the top. Scatter over the torn mozzarella and the cheddar.

steps.title: Bake and serve
steps.text: Bake on the middle shelf for 20 min, until golden and bubbling at the edges. Leave to settle for 2 min, then scatter with basil leaves (optional) and serve.

basedOn: Don't Go Bacon My Heart — Chicken Pasta Bake — Chris Collins

title: Cheesy Tuna & Sweetcorn Pasta Bake with Broccoli

ingredients.swap: Cook the sweetcorn in a small pan of boiling water for 3 min instead of with the pasta, and stir it into one half of the dish only before topping with cheese.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil and heat the grill to medium-high. Cut the broccoli into small florets, halve the cherry tomatoes and grate the cheddar. Drain the tuna.

steps.title: Cook the pasta and veg
steps.text: Cook the penne according to the pack, adding the broccoli and sweetcorn for the last 3 min. Scoop out a small mugful of the cooking water, then drain everything in a colander.

steps.title: Make the cheese sauce
steps.text: While the pasta cooks, melt the butter in a medium saucepan over a medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 min. Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 3–4 min, whisking, until thick enough to coat a spoon.

steps.title: Mix the bake
steps.text: Take the sauce off the heat and stir in two-thirds of the cheddar, the mustard and some salt and pepper. Fold in the pasta, veg and tuna, adding a splash of cooking water if it's stiff. Gently stir in half the tomatoes.

steps.title: Grill and serve
steps.text: Tip into a heatproof baking dish. Scatter over the remaining cheddar, the parmesan (optional) and the rest of the tomatoes. Grill for 5–6 min until golden and bubbling, then serve straight away.

basedOn: Tesco Real Food — Tuna Pasta Bake — Tesco Recipes team

title: Oven-Baked Chicken & Bacon Risotto with Spinach

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and boil the kettle. Finely chop the onion and bacon and grate the garlic. Cut the chicken into 2cm chunks. Crumble the stock cube into 550ml just-boiled water.

steps.title: Brown the chicken and bacon
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wide ovenproof pan or casserole with a lid over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken and bacon for 5 min, stirring, until golden. Add the onion, turn the heat to medium and cook for 4 min until soft.

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.text: Stir in the garlic for 30 sec, then add the risotto rice. Stir for 1–2 min until the edges of the grains look see-through.

steps.title: Bake the risotto
steps.text: Pour in the hot stock, add a good grind of pepper and bring to the boil. Cover with the lid, or tightly with foil, and bake on the middle shelf for 20–22 min. It's ready when the rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Take the pan out and stir in the spinach for 1–2 min until wilted. Beat in the butter and most of the parmesan until creamy, adding a splash of hot water if it's thick. Check the chicken is cooked through, taste for salt, and serve with the rest of the parmesan and a squeeze of lemon (optional).

basedOn: HelloFresh UK — Oven-Baked Bacon and Pea Risotto — HelloFresh recipe team
